title: Store input decomposition
description: Objective: split store input validation by record family while retaining one fail-closed normalization boundary. Deliverable: focused store-input modules with stable error outcomes and limits. NOT in scope: accepting new input shapes or weakening checks. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: packages/store/src/store-input.ts, new store-input-*.ts, and hostile/boundary tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Every currently invalid hostile input remains rejected with the same stable code.
No partial normalization or caller-owned mutable reference enters the store.
Every resulting production module is under 350 lines.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only tasks preserve public contracts and stable errors.
Do not weaken or rewrite tests to make the split pass.
Stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.

implementationPlan.description: Add a <=250-line direct characterization suite through the existing `./store-input.js` compatibility facade before moving code. Pin the exact 18 runtime exports and exact DurableStoreError codes/messages; table-test scalar/record/container boundaries (including nonplain objects, accessors, sparse/subclassed/non-index arrays, proxies and revoked proxies, SharedArrayBuffer/detached/oversized bytes); pin the existing combined-fault evaluation order; prove defaults for omitted metadata/headers, duplicate event/message and reserved-namespace rejection, decision-key freezing, deferred proposal-field reads, shared proposal/commit byte-budget order, and detached-copy isolation for every caller-owned array/record/Uint8Array. A revoked proxy array must fail closed as STORE_INPUT_INVALID by checking `types.isProxy` before `Array.isArray`; this changes no accepted shape and closes the known uncoded-throw hole. Leave all existing event-ledger, recovery, read-model, and command-decision tests byte-unchanged.
implementationPlan.note: Added a 220-line direct facade characterization suite covering the exact 18 exports, stable scalar/record/container errors, proxies/revoked proxies, sparse/subclass/non-index arrays, shared/detached/oversized bytes, combined-fault order, defaults, duplicates/reserved IDs, copy isolation, frozen decision keys, and deferred proposal reads. RED verified: focused Vitest ran 5 tests with exactly 1 expected failure—the revoked array proxy escapes TypeError instead of DurableStoreError at snapshotDenseArray—while the other 4 characterization tests passed.

implementationPlan.description: Extract the single shared fail-closed normalization boundary without semantic drift. Move invalidInput/limitExceeded plus identifier, integer, bigint, page-limit, timestamp, plain-data-record, and own-data-property validators into `store-input-primitives.ts`; move the intrinsic typed-array accessors, dense-array snapshot, and Uint8Array snapshot/budget logic into `store-input-containers.ts`. Preserve every message, proxy/prototype/descriptor check, UTF-8/NUL boundary, MAX_* comparison, SharedArrayBuffer/detached-byte handling, aggregate-budget decrement timing, returned mutability, and copy behavior verbatim except the proxy-first revoked-array hardening specified by the test. Add exact one-line `.js` strip-types bridges. Neither leaf imports the facade; containers depends only on primitives plus existing contracts/internals. Keep each TS file <=250 physical lines.

implementationPlan.description: Extract commit/event/outbox normalization into `store-input-commit.ts` and its one-line bridge. planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Considered a three-module split with scalar and container guards together (~220 lines), but rejected it because the user explicitly requires small production and test files and the four-module DAG leaves more change headroom while staying at the 10-path hard ceiling. Rejected editing oversized existing integration tests because the event/decision-ledger plans rely on them byte-unchanged and their ownership overlaps; one new <=250-line direct facade suite closes only decomposition seams. Rejected changing caller imports to leaf modules because the objective requires one stable fail-closed normalization boundary. Rejected freezing new result shapes or removing the deferred inputRecord alias because either would change observable/lazy behavior. The only intentional hardening is proxy-first array detection so an already-invalid revoked proxy returns the required stable code instead of escaping a TypeError.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Current store-input.ts is 485 lines with exactly 18 exports. All production callers import `./store-input.js`; package root does not expose these helpers. Existing store-input.js already re-exports store-input.ts and stays unchanged. Exact responsibility ranges are shared guards/containers (37-223), commit/event/outbox snapshot and reserved IDs (225-399), and decision request/metadata/proposal snapshot (401-485). Existing integration coverage lives in sqlite-event-store-core/recovery, command-decision store/integrity/concurrency, event-read-model-contract, and page-budget suites; none imports the module directly. New TS runtime imports need `.js` specifiers and tracked one-line `.js` bridges for Node strip-types smoke paths. Outputs are copied but generally not frozen; only CommandDecisionKey is frozen, and the deferred inputRecord alias is not persisted.
planningNotes.risks: Error precedence is highly non-obvious: message headers/payload/topic are validated before the parent eventType/metadata/payload, and top-level aggregate/command/time/version fields are last; moving apparently simpler validation earlier is a behavioral regression. snapshotCommittedProposal must share one MAX_COMMIT_BYTES budget and consume resultBytes first. Array.isArray throws on revoked proxies, so proxy detection must precede it without broadening accepted inputs. Do not freeze outputs, reject extra record properties, inspect deferred proposal fields on replay/stale paths, or replace intrinsic typed-array accessors with overridable getters. Existing ledger tasks may concurrently edit neighboring flat files/tests; preserve the compatibility facade and explicit-path commit discipline.
